last.a: said Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation

last.a: said KLA Chief Financial Officer Bren Higgins

last.q: KLA delivered strong March quarter results exceeding the midpoint of our guidance ranges on both revenue and earnings per share. Our business momentum remains robust, and we are highly confident in our outlook for calendar year 2026,
last.a: said Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation

last.q: KLA delivered a record quarter and calendar 2025 for revenue, non-GAAP operating income, and free cash flow generation. This performance was fueled by our differentiated product portfolio and solid company execution in an environment where the relevance of process control at the leading edge for foundry/logic and memor…
last.a: said Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation

last.q: KLA produced a strong all-around September quarter performance above the guidance midpoints. These results reflect double-digit year-over-year revenue and EPS growth, and KLA is on pace for solid relative revenue growth compared to our industry in calendar 2025,
last.a: said Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation
